project_name: HeatMap India – Digital Heatwave Risk Mapping for Indian Cities
project_type: Environmental Studies CA1 Academic Project / Interactive Climate Dashboard
theme_preference: Deep Charcoal / Obsidian Dark Mode (#0A0E17) with Thermal Thermal Accents (#F97316, #EF4444, #F59E0B, #10B981, #38BDF8)
design_vision: Transform an environmental studies college project into a high-precision, recognizably cartographic, publishable scientific web application. It combines authentic Indian geographic boundaries (dependency-free custom SVG with accurate coastline, peninsular taper, northern crown, and NE corridor), interactive zoom/pan/reset affordances, recalibrated latitude/longitude coordinates, state/region click filters, Punjab regional expansion (Ludhiana, Amritsar, Bathinda, Patiala, Jalandhar), multi-dimensional risk radars, transparent scoring calculators, and screenshot-friendly report-ready widgets.

cartography_and_map_specifications.approach: Recognizable, high-fidelity inline SVG map of India without external tile server dependencies

projection_calibration.notes: Ensure mercator-like linear scaling with calibrated offsets to accurately position Punjab in northwest, Delhi in NCR, Gujarat bulges in the west, Kolkata/Assam in east/northeast, and Kanyakumari/Kochi/Chennai in the southern cone.

interaction_features.pan_support: Drag & pan canvas with transform matrix or viewBox sliding
interaction_features.state_region_filtering: Clickable distinct SVG state paths/regions (North/Punjab, West/Gujarat-Rajasthan, Central/MP-Maharashtra, East/WB-Bihar-Odisha, South/Karnataka-TN-Kerala-Andhra-Telangana, Northeast/Assam)
interaction_features.marker_interaction: Hover tooltip + glowing radar pulse + click to inspect with deep dive stats in inspector panel

screenshot_safe_layout_rules.print_media_css: @media print { body { background: #0A0E17 !important; color: white !important; } .no-print { display: none !important; } }
screenshot_safe_layout_rules.card_padding: p-5 sm:p-7 with border-radius 16px and subtle 1px border so borders do not clip text when captured in slides
screenshot_safe_layout_rules.fixed_dimensions: Key charts must have explicit responsive containers and minimum heights (280px-350px) preventing layout shift during presentation screengrabs
screenshot_safe_layout_rules.export_view_mode: Include a toggle or clean view mode that expands charts and maps into a clean presentation sheet

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update backend /app/backend/models/cities.py and /app/backend/routers/cities.py to include Punjab cities (Ludhiana, Amritsar, Bathinda, Patiala, Jalandhar) and verified coordinates.

2. Replace the old schematic polygon in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx with an authentic, dependency-free inline SVG map of India. Use accurate SVG path geometry with recognizable Kashmir/Ladakh crown, Rajasthan bulge, Gujarat Rann & Kathiawar peninsula, southern triangle down to Kanyakumari, and Northeast corridor.
3. Implement zoom, pan, and reset controls on the SVG map using SVG transform matrices (scale & translate) with smooth transitions.
4. Add clickable region filters (All India, Punjab & North, West, Central, South, East, Northeast) that zoom and filter the active nodes.
5. Ensure marker positions strictly use the calibrated coordinate formula to map lat/lng into SVG coordinates without drift.
6. Keep the existing responsive layout, enhance styling with deep obsidian backgrounds, thermal amber/orange/red risk colors, and glassmorphic headers.
7. Add authentic source cards for IMD, NDMA, ISRO Bhuvan, and Punjab SAPCC with explicit educational disclaimers.
8. Ensure every single interactive element has a strict 'data-testid' attribute for end-to-end testing verification.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic SaaS blue/white cards. Use tactile scientific styling with JetBrains Mono data figures, Space Grotesk section titles, crisp 1px borders, and thermal heat glows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_discipline: Deep Obsidian background (#0A0E17) with high-contrast thermal scale (#EF4444 Very High, #F97316 High, #F59E0B Moderate, #10B981 Low). Never use muddy full-screen gradients.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_compliance: All buttons, inputs, links, badges, tabs, and map markers MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.performance: Dependency-free inline SVG ensures instantaneous rendering with zero tile loading lag or external API rate limits.
